target: Derive a formal or quantitative account of experience replay using a provenance-bound replay buffer. Use a reviewer who did not author the artifact or see hidden answers.

competency.title: Derive experience replay — human review
competency.outcome: Derive a formal or quantitative account of experience replay using a provenance-bound replay buffer. Use a reviewer who did not author the artifact or see hidden answers.

topic_kernel.measure: retention per byte and sample age

competency.practice_task: Produce a stepwise derivation with units or invariants grounded in a provenance-bound replay buffer.
competency.setting_constraint: Use a reviewer who did not author the artifact or see hidden answers.
required_evidence: a stepwise derivation with units or invariants
Include reviewer notes, disagreement resolution and audit trail.
Report retention per byte and sample age with uncertainty or an explicit deterministic check.
Construct a negative control for the failure mode: replaying evaluation examples.

assessment.scoring: Each criterion: 0 absent, 1 partial, 2 demonstrated; require 2 on all four.
assessment.threshold_policy: Register the metric threshold, baseline, task budget and evaluator before exposing new items.
criteria: Concept: correctly state the assumptions and limits of experience replay.
Practice: the derivation reproduces a checked special case.
Measurement: report retention per byte and sample age against a matched baseline with reproducible inputs.
Critical check: test for replaying evaluation examples; detect it or rule it out with evidence.

competency.source_policy: Reviewer must add a verified primary source before lesson status; no source is fabricated here.
competency.contamination_policy: No private items, answers, seeds or reviewer-only prompts in this public specification.
